## Setup

The demo starts with synthetic versions of the cleaned survey files. In the original workflow, the cleaning notebook created `final_clean` and `final_clean_filtered` before the reporting notebook ran.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# Add your own Google Sheet ID here to upload. Leave blank to run locally.
sheet_id <- ""

final_clean <- read_csv("data/demo/cleaned_unfiltered_demo.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
final_clean_filtered <- final_clean %>% filter(status == "included")
wrangled <- read_csv("data/demo/wrangled_demo.csv", col_types = cols(source = col_character()))
codes <- read_csv("data/demo/source_codes_demo.csv", col_types = cols(source = col_character()))

dir.create("output/original-demo", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
run_date <- Sys.Date()
```

## Response counts and demographics

```{r entry-counts}
# Count all cleaned responses and the responses included in the report.
all_n <- nrow(final_clean)
included_n <- nrow(final_clean_filtered)

entry_counts_row <- tibble(
  label = c("Date", "All Responses", "Included Responses"),
  value = c(
    as.character(run_date),
    all_n,
    paste0(included_n, " (", round(included_n / all_n * 100, 1), "%)")
  )
)

write_csv(entry_counts_row, "output/original-demo/entry_counts.csv")
knitr::kable(entry_counts_row)
```

```{r demographics}
summarize_section <- function(data, var, section_name) {
  total_n <- nrow(data)

  data %>%
    count({{ var }}, name = "count") %>%
    mutate(
      per = round(count / total_n, 2),
      total = total_n,
      section = section_name,
      variable = as.character({{ var }})
    ) %>%
    select(section, variable, count, per, total)
}

gen_tbl            <- summarize_section(wrangled, gender_2, "Gender")
race_tbl           <- summarize_section(wrangled, race_census, "Race")
borough_tbl        <- summarize_section(wrangled, borough, "Borough")
religion_tbl       <- summarize_section(wrangled, relig, "Religion")
education_tbl      <- summarize_section(wrangled, sch_level, "Education")
income_tbl         <- summarize_section(wrangled, income, "Income")
lowinc_tbl         <- summarize_section(wrangled, below_poverty_bi, "Below Poverty / Low Income")
disable_tbl        <- summarize_section(wrangled, hh_disability, "Household With a Disability")
nytime_tbl         <- summarize_section(wrangled, res_length, "Length of Time in NYC")
res_type_tbl       <- summarize_section(wrangled, res_type, "Housing")
rent_type_tbl      <- summarize_section(wrangled, res_type_rent, "Renters")
not_eng_tbl        <- summarize_section(wrangled, not_eng, "Another Language")
lgbtq_tbl          <- summarize_section(wrangled, lgbtq, "LGBTQIA+")
senior_tbl         <- summarize_section(wrangled, senior, "Respondent Is a Senior")
hh_elderly_tbl     <- summarize_section(wrangled, hh_elderly, "Household With Seniors")
hh_child_tbl       <- summarize_section(wrangled, hh_child, "Household With Children")
hh_child_young_tbl <- summarize_section(wrangled, hh_child_young, "Household With Young Children")
unemp_bi_tbl       <- summarize_section(wrangled, unemp_bi, "Respondent Is Unemployed")

# The spreadsheet layout has two blank rows between demographic sections.
blank_rows <- tibble(count = c(NA_real_, NA_real_), per = c(NA_real_, NA_real_))

final_tbl <- bind_rows(
  gen_tbl, blank_rows,
  race_tbl, blank_rows,
  borough_tbl, blank_rows,
  religion_tbl, blank_rows,
  education_tbl, blank_rows,
  income_tbl, blank_rows,
  lowinc_tbl, blank_rows,
  disable_tbl, blank_rows,
  nytime_tbl, blank_rows,
  res_type_tbl, blank_rows,
  rent_type_tbl, blank_rows,
  not_eng_tbl, blank_rows,
  lgbtq_tbl, blank_rows,
  senior_tbl, blank_rows,
  hh_elderly_tbl, blank_rows,
  hh_child_tbl, blank_rows,
  hh_child_young_tbl, blank_rows,
  unemp_bi_tbl
)

write_csv(final_tbl, "output/original-demo/demographics_summary.csv")
knitr::kable(final_tbl %>% filter(!is.na(section)))
```

## Source codes

```{r source-codes}
sourcecodes <- wrangled %>%
  mutate(
    source = if_else(str_detect(source, "^r"), "r", source),
    source = if_else(str_detect(source, "^\\d+p"), str_sub(source, end = -2), source)
  ) %>%
  count(source, name = "count") %>%
  mutate(per = round(count / sum(count), 2), total = sum(count)) %>%
  slice(gtools::mixedorder(source)) %>%
  left_join(codes, by = "source")

date_row <- tibble(source = paste("Run Date:", run_date, "| Total N:", nrow(wrangled)))
block_to_write_sc <- bind_rows(date_row, sourcecodes)

write_csv(block_to_write_sc, "output/original-demo/source_codes_summary.csv")
knitr::kable(sourcecodes)
```

## Google Sheets

Upload is optional. Install `googlesheets4` and enter a sheet ID in Setup. The destination spreadsheet needs tabs named exactly `Sheet1` and `source codes`. Create any missing tabs manually. On a blank `Sheet1`, the notebook fills in the section and category labels in columns A and B and writes the first run in columns C and D.

```{r upload-to-sheets}
if (nzchar(sheet_id)) {
  library(googlesheets4)
  gs4_auth()

  demographics_tab <- "Sheet1"
  sources_tab <- "source codes"
  missing_tabs <- setdiff(c(demographics_tab, sources_tab), sheet_names(sheet_id))
  if (length(missing_tabs) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0("Create these tabs in Google Sheets before uploading: ",
             paste(sQuote(missing_tabs), collapse = ", ")),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  source("write_demographics_run.R", local = TRUE)
  write_demographics_run(sheet_id, demographics_tab, entry_counts_row, final_tbl)

  # Append the new source block below the previous run.
  existing_sources <- read_sheet(sheet_id, sheet = sources_tab, col_names = FALSE)
  start_row <- if (nrow(existing_sources) == 0) 1 else nrow(existing_sources) + 3

  range_write(
    sheet_id, sheet = sources_tab, data = block_to_write_sc,
    range = cell_limits(ul = c(start_row, 1)), col_names = TRUE
  )
  message("Wrote recruitment sources to ", sources_tab, " starting at row ", start_row, ".")
}
```
